prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1340; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's all right.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in the right lane on the main road in Sugar Land, heading toward the shopping center exit. Traffic was moving pretty steadily.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was changing lanes to the left to get around a slow truck. I checked my mirror and it looked clear, so I signaled and started moving over.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not until it was right there. I felt a bump on my side and heard a scrape. The other car had come up in my blind spot, I think.
Q: Did either of you stop after the contact?
A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver was apologetic and said they didn't see me coming.
Q: Were you injured?
A: My neck and lower back hurt right away. Mostly stiffness at first, but by the next morning the pain was sharper, especially when I turn my head or lift anything.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day and I'm scheduled for physical therapy. They diagnosed a neck and back strain.
Q: Did you have any passengers in your vehicle?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble sleeping because of the pain. Otherwise, that's everything I remember.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
